title: Great bell of Tōdai-ji
status_note: National Treasure; one of Japan's Three Famous Bells.

place.label: Shōrō bell tower, Tōdai-ji, Nara
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

timeline.event: Dates from the temple's founding period in the 8th century (exact year [UNKNOWN])

tiers.everyday: Tōdai-ji's great bell in Nara weighs 26.3 tonnes and dates from the temple's founding in the 700s. It is struck with a big wooden beam rather than a clapper.
tiers.student: Tōdai-ji gives 26.3 t; Nara City gives 3.86 m total height and 2.71 m diameter, a bell tower rebuilt in 1210 and a zelkova striking beam 4.48 m long and 180 kg. Like other bonshō it has no clapper. Exact casting year [UNKNOWN] (pinned as approximate 752).

model.label: Parametric profile scaled from the sourced diameter and height; the curve itself is a generic Western bell profile, not a scan.
